question.text: Per Reg 23, the PPM (Private Placement Memorandum) of a Cat II AIF must contain:

answer.text: Only fee structure; valuation is separately disclosed to SEBI
Names of prospective investee companies only
Details of the valuation methodology and approach adopted for each asset class of the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: The PPM of an AIF shall contain details of the valuation methodology and approach adopted for each asset class of the scheme. The PPM is the primary investor disclosure document for the fund's valuation framework. The Trap: Option A wrongly restricts the PPM to fee structure. Option B reduces the PPM to a single item that is not the core valuation requirement. Option C reduces the PPM to IRR projections, which is not the relevant valuation-methodology disclosure. Note: The workbook supports the Reg 23 requirement that the PPM contain valuation methodology and approach for each asset class of the scheme.
